rationale.ai-review: Secondary auditor model judges agent reasoning and generated artifacts.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Sandboxed behavioral analysis and integrity checks detect grounded security failures.
rationale.ai-code-insecurity: Original AVT classifies security vulnerabilities unique to agentic coding pipelines.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: SSA and governance monitors detect divergence from intent and policy.
rationale.org-governance: Live risk register, policy gates, and GRC integration operationalize governance.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Architecture maps controls and audit evidence to NIST and ISO requirements.
rationale.tooling-supply-chain: Taxonomy and controls address poisoned tool outputs and compromised agent tooling.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Signed persistent lineage enables human forensic review of AI-generated changes.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes incrementally extending SAST and DAST for agentic security.
rationale.framework: UAST is a reusable five-layer architecture for development pipelines.
rationale.design-only: Authors explicitly state UAST is a logical architecture, not implemented.
rationale.agentic: Targets autonomous agents producing and deploying artifact-level code changes.
rationale.steering: Security signals and policy constraints substantively shape agents' generation context.
rationale.metrics: ARSM defines a quantitative security risk score extending CVSS.
rationale.risk-security: Taxonomy, score, and architecture analyze and mitigate security harms.
